rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification covering LVI and sahko (electrical) contracting, the relevant trades for this estate.
Visakoivu Oy employs 62 LVI professionals in its own workforce, comfortably exceeding this requirement.
Visakoivu Oy holds a valid F-kaasu (F-gas) qualification covering refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment, which applies to the shared cooling systems on this estate.
Visakoivu Oy holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate, valid until 31 December 2026, which remains in force at the quotation closing date of 16 October 2026.
Visakoivu Oy holds a qualifying reference project above this value: REF01 (Haavikkoranta Oy, LVI- ja sahkoylapidon ulkoistus, tuotantokiinteisto, 2021-2022) at EUR 640,000.
Visakoivu Oy employs 48 electrical (sahko) professionals in its own workforce, exceeding this requirement.

Visakoivu Oy's occupational safety plan for this estate operates under its NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety management system, and covers site induction for all personnel, permit-to-work procedures for hot work and work at height, coordination with individual tenants' own safety rules, and incident reporting to the Buyer within 24 hours of any occurrence.
Visakoivu Oy offers a warranty period of 24 months on equipment and materials installed under this agreement, running from the date of commissioning of each item.

Statutory lift inspections for the estate's goods and passenger lifts will be scheduled with an accredited inspection body at the intervals required by the Lift Safety Decree, with inspection certificates and any resulting corrective actions logged in the maintenance record and copied to the Buyer's facilities contact.

Waste generated during maintenance work is sorted at source into recyclable, hazardous (including refrigerants and used oils), and mixed waste streams, collected via licensed waste carriers, and logged so that a waste transfer record can be produced to the Buyer on request.

Common spare parts (filters, belts, valves, sensors) are typically available from stock or regional suppliers within 3-5 working days; for discontinued equipment, Visakoivu Oy sources refurbished or compatible replacement parts, or proposes a like-for-like component upgrade where original parts are no longer manufactured.

Completed work is quality-checked under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, including a documented sign-off inspection before a job is closed and periodic internal audits of completed maintenance visits.

Environmental impacts during works are managed under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system, covering spill prevention, correct handling of refrigerants and other regulated substances, and minimising disruption to tenants' operations during works.

The condition of roofing, cladding, and building fabric across the four buildings is assessed through an annual visual condition survey per building, supplemented by ad hoc inspection following any weather event likely to have caused damage, with findings recorded in a condition report to the Buyer.

Scheduled maintenance visits are proposed on a monthly basis for HVAC and electrical systems and quarterly for building automation and life-safety systems, with the exact content and frequency for each building agreed with the Buyer at contract start.

Personnel carry photo identification and sign in with the relevant tenant's reception or security point before entering any tenanted building, in line with each tenant's own site rules; access outside normal hours is arranged in advance with the tenant and the Buyer's facilities contact.

Maintenance activity and outstanding items are reported to the Buyer's facilities contact through a monthly maintenance report covering completed visits, open faults, and any items requiring the Buyer's decision, with urgent items flagged as they arise rather than held for the monthly cycle.

Proposed response times are: critical faults (life-safety, loss of heating/cooling to occupied space) within 2 hours; urgent faults within 4 hours; routine faults within 1 working day. Out-of-hours cover is provided through an on-call rota reachable by phone outside normal working hours, seven days a week.

The existing asset register and technical documentation will be received from the outgoing contractor or the Buyer at handover, verified against a physical walk-through of each building, and maintained thereafter as a live record updated whenever equipment is replaced or added.

Proposed response times for corrective (non-emergency) maintenance requests are: within 2 working days for requests affecting tenant operations, and within 5 working days for other corrective items, subject to parts availability.

Training for the Buyer's own facilities staff is provided at handover and after any significant system change, covering basic operation of building automation controls, fault-reporting procedure, and what to check before calling out the on-call service.

Any subcontracted trades are selected from Visakoivu Oy's approved subcontractor list, vetted for the relevant trade qualification and insurance cover before appointment, and supervised by a named Visakoivu Oy site lead who remains the Buyer's single point of contact regardless of which trade is performing the work.

A fault not resolved within the agreed response time is escalated first to the Visakoivu Oy service manager responsible for the estate, and if still unresolved, to Visakoivu Oy's operations director, with the Buyer's facilities contact copied at each escalation step.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a bonus-malus scheme under which sustained over-performance against agreed service levels over a review period earns a modest bonus payment, and sustained under-performance triggers a corresponding reduction, with the percentages and review period to be agreed with the Buyer.

Visakoivu Oy proposes indexation using the Finnish Statistical Bureau's building maintenance cost index (kiinteistön yllapidon kustannusindeksi), with January of each contract year as the reference month for calculating the following year's adjustment.
Visakoivu Oy confirms its acceptance of the payment terms set out in this request and its annexes.
Visakoivu Oy proposes monthly invoicing in arrears and confirms its capability to issue electronic invoices in Finvoice or Peppol BIS format as required by the Buyer.
Visakoivu Oy proposes a notice period of three months for termination for convenience by either party, and immediate termination for material breach not remedied within 30 days of written notice.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a fixed monthly charge for scheduled maintenance under this agreement, with corrective work outside the scheduled scope charged on a time-and-materials basis at agreed hourly rates.
All prices quoted by Visakoivu Oy are in euro.

The completed reference form (Liite 2) is enclosed with this quotation, listing REF01 (Haavikkoranta Oy, LVI- ja sahkoylapidon ulkoistus, tuotantokiinteisto), REF05 (Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, koulukiinteistojen LVI-ylapito, puitesopimus), and REF09 (Nareikko Teollisuus Oy, rakennusautomaatio- ja sahkourakka, tehdaslaajennus) as the reference projects relied upon to satisfy Section 2, each comfortably exceeding the value threshold in clause 2.5.
A current certificate of pension insurance payments is enclosed with this quotation.
A current certificate of tax payment is enclosed with this quotation.
A description of Visakoivu Oy's quality system is enclosed, summarising the NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system under which the company operates.
This quotation document uses a minimum font size of 11 pt throughout.
This quotation will be submitted electronically as a single PDF file to the delivery channel specified by the Buyer; no printed copies are proposed unless the Buyer specifically requests them.
This quotation notes the submission deadline as 16 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time (EET/EEST as applicable), as stated in Section 7.
All pricing in this quotation is expressed in euro as the reference currency.
All monetary figures in this quotation are rounded to two decimal places.

Personnel working across the tenanted buildings hold the trade qualifications relevant to their discipline -- LUSA-qualified LVI and electrical tradespeople, sahkourakointioikeudet class S1 for electrical work, and F-kaasu qualification for refrigeration work -- together with the site-induction and identification requirements set out in Section 3 above.

The method statement for installation and replacement work covers advance scheduling with the affected tenant, use of screened work areas and out-of-hours working where practicable to minimise disruption to tenants' operations, and a post-work handover check with the tenant before the area is released.

Maintenance of refrigeration and cooling equipment serving the shared systems is carried out under Visakoivu Oy's F-kaasu qualification, including leak-checking at the statutory intervals for the refrigerant charge involved and logged refrigerant records as required by the F-gas regulation.

The HVAC maintenance agreement proposed for the shared systems covers monthly scheduled maintenance of air handling units and ventilation plant, with filter changes and performance checks at each visit and an annual deep-clean and performance test of the full system.

Continuity of service through staff changes is maintained by assigning at least two Visakoivu Oy technicians familiarity with each site, maintaining up-to-date handover notes and the asset register for every property, and a documented handover period before any reassigned technician is replaced on the account.

Statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations across the estate is carried out by Visakoivu Oy's sahkourakointioikeudet class S1 qualified electricians at the intervals required for the installation type, with inspection reports and any required remedial works logged and reported to the Buyer.

Fire protection systems across the four buildings are tested and maintained on a scheduled basis in line with the manufacturer's and statutory testing intervals for each system type (detection, extinguishing, emergency lighting), with test records retained and made available to the Buyer.
Visakoivu Oy will give the relevant tenant at least 48 hours' notice before accessing tenanted areas, except where an emergency response situation requires immediate access.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a discount of 2% on call-off values once combined annual order volume exceeds an agreed first threshold, rising to 4% beyond a second, higher threshold, with the exact thresholds to be agreed with the Buyer at contract start.

Visakoivu Oy's position on a contractual penalty for shortfall in service level is a service-credit deduction of 2% of the affected month's maintenance charge for each missed response-time threshold in that month, capped at 10% of the month's charge.
Visakoivu Oy will price the shared-system maintenance scope in euro per square metre per year, not in euro per month, as required.
Visakoivu Oy confirms that prices quoted in this quotation remain valid for 90 days from the closing date given in Section 7 of the main request.
A confidentiality undertaking, signed by an authorised representative of Visakoivu Oy, is enclosed with this quotation.

This quotation will be signed by a registered signatory of Visakoivu Oy; a power of attorney is therefore not required. Should signature by a representative who is not a registered signatory become necessary, a power of attorney will be enclosed before submission.
A trade register extract for Visakoivu Oy (business ID 1876543-2), issued no earlier than three months before the closing date, will be enclosed with this quotation.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation in response to TKR-RFQ-2026-07 for technical maintenance services across the Rautavaara industrial estate. Visakoivu Oy meets all six eligibility requirements in Section 2 and has reviewed this request together with its four annexes in full.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company employing 180 staff across LVI, electrical, building automation, and property maintenance disciplines, serving public and private clients across Keski-Suomi and neighbouring regions.
